answer_1.quote: We propose a conditional generation model to tackle temporal event ordering and event infilling... The goal of event infilling is to generate inserted events at some pre-selected insertion positions...
answer_1.outputs: temporal event sequences and generated events

answer_2.quote: We compute the pairwise accuracy of the predicted event sequences... the averaged accuracy on predicting the order... top-1 and top-2 exact match (EM)...

answer_4.quote: We evaluate the quality of the generated (inserted) events by human evaluation on Amazon Mechanical Turk. Specifically, we randomly sample 30 examples from CaTeRS and have 5 raters judge the coherence and temporality...
answer_4.guideline: The prompt includes asking raters to check grammaticality, then separately judge coherence and temporality on a scale from 0 to 2.
